scripts.name: Flick Macro
scripts.description: Original v2. Hold the key to keep hopping. Release to stop.

scripts.name: Flick Jump Combo
scripts.description: You jump yourself. Press the key for the flick + boost Space only. No auto jump before the flick.

scripts.name: Flick Macro (Queue)
scripts.description: Untested. A press during a hop is queued and fires right after it.

scripts.name: Flick Macro (Chain)
scripts.description: Tested, little improvement. Shifts the delay earlier on rapid presses, but presses are still dropped.

scripts.name: Flick Macro (Restart)
scripts.description: Tested, chains did not work. Every press cancels the current hop and restarts it.
